properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The "Poly1305" hits are all uses of the golang.org/x/crypto/chacha20poly1305 package — the ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD that wraps file keys in stanzas (aeadEncrypt/aeadDecrypt in primitives.go) and encrypts the payload stream. Not quantum-vulnerable (symmetric), part of the age v1 spec.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RSA handling for the ssh-rsa recipient/identity in the agessh package (key parsing at agessh.go:58-66/:285-286, test keygens in agessh_test.go) — compatibility path reusing existing SSH keys for age encryption.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X25519 is age's standard classic recipient/identity: ephemeral X25519 ECDH (x25519.go:65-98 Wrap, curve25519.X25519), HKDF-SHA256 wrap key, Bech32 age1/AGE-SECRET-KEY encodings (parse.go, internal/bech32), GenerateX25519Identity/ParseX25519Identity APIs, plus the same X25519 ECDH inside agessh's ssh-ed25519 path and the ML-KEM768+X25519 hybrid. Quantum-vulnerable key agreement (Shor) — the primary harvest-now-decrypt-later surface of every pre-1.2 age file. Migration: HybridRecipient (ML-KEM-768

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 (ssh-ed25519) support in the agessh package: Ed25519Recipient/Identity convert Ed25519 keys to Curve25519 points (ed25519PublicKeyToCurve25519 via edwards25519.BytesMontgomery; ed25519PrivateKeyToCurve25519 via SHA-512 of the seed) and then run X25519 ECDH for key wrapping. Also Ed25519 keygen in tests. The Ed25519 keys themselves are Shor-vulnerable; their use for ECDH is the quantum-relevant path.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: P-256 key agreement in the tag package: classic tagged recipients ("age1tag1") parse a compressed P-256 point via nistec and hpke.DHKEM(ecdh.P256()) (tag.go:74-78), with the same DHKEM deriving test keypairs in tag/internal/tagtest.go:26; plugin/encode.go:89/:100 enforce the X25519 curve for native recipient encoding helpers. The classic P-256 tagged recipient is quantum-vulnerable ECDH (Shor) — harvest-now-decrypt-later applies to files encrypted with age1tag1 recipients; the post-quantum count

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt is age's passphrase KDF: ScryptRecipient/ScryptIdentity (scrypt.go) wrap the file key with scrypt.Key(password, salt, 1<<logN, 8, 1, 32) — default work factor logN=18 (2^18, "1s on a modern machine"), 16-byte random salt prefixed with the age-encryption.org/v1/scrypt label, SetWorkFactor allows 1..30. Also used by the age-plugin-batchpass plugin (batch passphrase encryption) and exercised throughout the test suites. Symmetric KDF — Grover only halves the password search space; the quantum

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Post-quantum side of the inventory: ML-KEM-768 + X25519 hybrid (hpke.MLKEM768X25519) is the default modern age key — HybridRecipient/HybridIdentity (pq.go:36), age1pq1 Bech32 encoding, age-keygen -pq (keygen.go), the age-plugin-pq compatibility plugin, and the tagpq plugin's ML-KEM-768+P-256 variant. Not quantum-vulnerable; the migration target for the classic X25519 recipient. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256 throughout the age core: HKDF-SHA256 for stanza wrapping keys (x25519.go:88, agessh.go:223/238/335/344), HMAC-SHA256 for the header MAC (primitives.go:52-62), OAEP hash and sshFingerprint in agessh, streamKey HKDF (primitives.go:65-66). Symmetric hash, Grover-resistant at 256 bits; not Shor-vulnerable.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: HKDF-SHA256 is age's core KDF: derives the ChaCha20-Poly1305 wrapping key from the X25519 shared secret (x25519.go:88), the header MAC key (primitives.go:53), the payload stream key (primitives.go:66), and agessh's Ed25519-to-X25519 tweak and wrapping keys (agessh.go:223/:238/:335/:344), each with a domain-separation label from the age v1 spec. Symmetric KDF, not Shor-vulnerable.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD (golang.org/x/crypto/chacha20poly1305): wraps the 128-bit file key inside every recipient stanza (aeadEncrypt/aeadDecrypt, primitives.go:19-50, with fixed zero nonce justified by one-time keys) and encrypts the payload stream (internal/stream/stream.go). Core age v1 primitive, symmetric, not Shor-vulnerable. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: crypto/rand (OS CSPRNG) is the sole randomness source in the codebase: ephemeral X25519 scalars (x25519.go:67, agessh.go:209), scrypt salts (scrypt.go:66), RSA-OAEP and ssh keygen (agessh.go:81, agessh_test.go), identity generation (cmd/age-keygen), and the wordlist-based passphrase generator in cmd/age/wordlist.go. A CSPRNG is a posture asset: no weak PRNG reaches key material (math/rand is confined to protocol grease, tracked separately).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: x/crypto/ssh key handling for the agessh compatibility path: ssh.ParseAuthorizedKey for ssh-rsa/ssh-ed25519 recipients, ssh.NewSignerFromKey and ssh.ParseRawPrivateKey for identities, and ssh.ParseRawPrivateKeyWithPassphrase (agessh/encrypted_keys.go:104) for passphrase-protected OpenSSH keys — the latter triggers x/crypto/ssh's internal bcrypt-PBKDF decryption of the openssh-key-v1 format. Key-management infrastructure feeding the RSA-OAEP and X25519 wrap paths.
